body.name: F_knownE
body.construction: For a supplied \(E\), set \(\widetilde C_k=C_k-E\) and define \[\mathcal F_{\mathrm{known}}(E)=\left\{W\in\mathbb R^{p\times p}:\begin{array}{l}\widetilde C_k\succ0\text{ for }k\in K,\quad W\widetilde C_kW^{\mathsf T}=\widetilde C_{k+1}\text{ for }k=0,1,2,\\ Wd_0=d_1,\quad Wd_1=d_2,\quad \rho(W)<1,\quad \operatorname{spec}(W)\cap(-\infty,0]=\varnothing,\\ E_W=E\quad\text{equivalently}\quad C_0-E-T_W=0\end{array}\right\}.\]
